skill.summary: Autonomously stake MOLT or V3 LP NFTs on Base to earn KELP rewards, auto-harvest for others, and receive 3.5% keeper fees.

latestVersion.changelog:
Kelp Forest Agent Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Kelp Forest agent and keeper scripts for autonomous yield farming on Base.
- Supports registering as an agent, staking MOLT, and earning KELP with auto-harvest capabilities.
- Includes fee-earning mechanisms for agents who harvest for others (3.5% keeper fee).
- Provides migration guidance for previous V1/V3 users to V4 contracts.
- Detailed setup instructions and example scripts for agent operation and keeper automation.
